Rename AdminCP Directory <dfn>Renaming the AdminCP directory can increase security for exploits that target files in this directory.</dfn>

The AdminCP directory should be renamed via the PATH TO ADMIN & MODERATOR CONTROL PANELS section of the includes/config.php file like this:

$config['Misc']['admincpdir'] = 'notadmincp';

Note: If you perform this tweak, you need to manually ensure that modifications (such as other DBTech mods) that place files in the ./admincp folder have those files placed in your new folder when installing the modifications.
Do not perform this tweak if you do not feel confident you can keep modifications from breaking in this manner.

If you are running a WHM/cPanel-based server (VPS or Dedicated), you should log in to WHM and enable CSF (ConfigServer Security&Firewall).

By default, the firewall is active, but in "TEST MODE" - follow the instructions on-screen to disable test mode.

In addition, you should click "Check Server Security" and follow as many of the recommendations there as you can without negatively impacting your server.

Enabling the Firewall helps prevent people attempting to exploit your server, and blocks people who attempts to access your FTP accounts with invalid logins (also known as "Brute Force Attempts").

When following the server security recommendations, you may wish to leave "Check php for ini_set disabled" and "Check max emails per hour is set" without following those recommendations, as disabling those may negatively impact the functionality of your XenForo software.
